class.name: RailVehicleEnginePowerSource
class.brief_description: What a vehicle's traction is fed from: the source and its current collector.
class.description: The kind of source (FIZ [code]Power: EnginePower=[/code]) and, for one fed from the catenary, the current collector - the pantographs, their valves, tank and compressor, the voltage they bring and the energy meter. A car of a multiple unit without an engine of its own (31WE/ED78 B and C) has one too and carries the unit's pantographs. Its pantograph commands ([code]pantograph[/code], [code]pantographs_valve[/code], ...) and the [code]current_collector/*[/code] keys of the state dump are this component's.
